item.title: Investigation underway after overnight shooting on Market Street
item.description: Around 3:15 am Sunday, Wilmington Police officers heard gunshots in the 100 block of Market Street, coming from the nearby parking deck.

item.title: Democrat Roy Cooper needs to defy North Carolina history to keep winning streak alive in Senate race
item.description: North Carolina is a perennial political battleground that often renders a split verdict. Democrats have kept their grip on the governor's office for more than a century, ceding it to only three Republicans during that time. Since 1968, Republican presidential candidates have won the state in every election except for 1976 and for 2008 — the same year a Democrat last won a Senate race.

item.title: NFL’s free-agent spending frenzy begins first with a legal tampering period
item.description: The NFL’s free agency period opens Monday with a 52-hour legal tampering period ahead of the official start of the new league year Wednesday.

item.title: On 61st anniversary of Bloody Sunday, worries about the future of voting rights and calls to action
item.description: Sixty-one years after state troopers attacked Civil Rights marchers on the Edmund Pettus Bridge in Selma, thousands gathered in the Alabama city this weekend, amid new concerns about the future of the Voting Rights Act.

item.title: Pixar’s ‘Hoppers’ bounds to No. 1 as Warner Bros.’ ‘The Bride!’ is on life support
item.description: Disney and Pixar’s environmental adventure “Hoppers” topped the North American box office this weekend with $46 million in domestic ticket sales in its opening weekend, according to studio estimates Sunday.

item.title: Iran war’s toll on civilian targets grows
item.description: The war toll on civilian targets grew Sunday in the Middle East as Bahrain accused Iran of striking a desalination plant vital to drinking water supplies, and oil depots in Tehran smoldered following overnight Israeli strikes.

item.title: After Rick Southerland’s drop out, plans are set on how the seat will be filled
item.description: Plans are set to who will replace Rick Southerland's spot in the New Hanover County Board of Education race.

item.description: Around 1:30 am Sunday, officers responded to a ShotSpotter alert in the 1300 block of Dawson Street.

item.title: “Roar for Hope” event helps celebrate International Women’s Day
item.description: At Broomtail Brewing, several people attended "Roar for Hope", an event to help celebrate international Women's day, and help domestic violence victims.

item.title: International Women’s Day is a celebration and a call to action. Here are things to know
item.description: Women across the world called for equal pay, reproductive rights, education, justice and decision-making jobs and celebrate progress toward female empowerment during events and demonstrations marking International Women’s Day on Sunday.
